results.title: PHP runtime environment | App Engine standard environment | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: Documentation · Application hosting · App Engine · Standard environment · Guides · Send feedback · The PHP runtime is the software stack responsible for installing your web service's code and its dependencies and running your service. To specify PHP for the App Engine standard environment, declare the runtime in the app.yaml file.

results.title: Building an app with PHP | App Engine standard environment | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: Learn how to build an app in App Engine using either PHP version 7.4 or 8.1. The sample app allows users to post the titles, authors, descriptions, publication date, and images of their favorite books to a webpage.

results.title: The php.ini File | App Engine standard environment | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: Documentation · Application hosting · App Engine · Standard environment · Reference · Send feedback · You can include a php.ini file with your App Engine application. This file lets you customize the behavior of the PHP interpreter directives. See an example of the default php.ini configuration.

results.title: Specifying dependencies | App Engine standard environment | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: You can declare dependencies for PHP in a standard composer.json file.

results.title: App Engine standard environment for PHP 7.x and 8.1+ release notes | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: For new projects you create after March 2025, App Engine sets the automatic scaling maximum instances default for standard environment deployments to 20. This change doesn't impact existing apps. To override the default, specify a new max_instances value in your app.yaml file, and deploy a new version or redeploy over an existing version. Custom organization policies for Serverless VPC Access connectors are now generally available, and can be applied to projects, folders, or organizations. The runtime support schedule for some PHP runtimes has been extended to match PHP's public support schedule.

results.title: Upgrade an existing application | App Engine standard environment | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: Documentation · Application hosting · App Engine · Standard environment · Guides · Send feedback · You must upgrade your applications to the latest supported runtime version to continue receiving security updates and be eligible for technical support. The process of upgrading an existing app depends on the runtime version that your app currently uses: PHP 5.5 (first-generation runtime): You must migrate your app to the latest supported PHP version.

results.title: Allowing Users to Upload Files | App Engine standard environment for PHP 5 | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: The PHP runtime forms the correct $_FILES super global, and tmp_filename refers to the filename of the newly uploaded file in Google Cloud Storage.

results.title: Access legacy bundled services for PHP | App Engine standard environment | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: This page describes how to install and use the bundled services with the PHP runtime for the App Engine standard environment.
